metaTitle: Custom Direct to Garment Socks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment socks in bulk. Vibrant, all-over prints for your brand. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct-to-garment printing on socks allows for full-color, detailed designs that wrap around the entire sock. Unlike traditional embroidery or screen printing, DTG gives you photorealistic logos, gradients, and intricate patterns without raised threads. This is ideal for marketing teams wanting bold, all-over branding or safety managers creating fun, custom crew socks for uniform compliance. The soft hand feel ensures comfort for all-day wear.
heroAltText: Custom direct to garment socks with full-color all-over print design, perfect for corporate branding and giveaways.
